title: Customer Care Policy on Meal Vouchers, Hotel Nights and Goodwill for Crestline Disruptions
content:
**Service recovery policy — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** Meal vouchers, hotel nights and goodwill are provided only when the disruption record's cause is controllable; an uncontrollable disruption receives rebooking but no meal voucher, hotel night or goodwill.

## Care

- A controllable disruption whose arrival lateness reaches the fare brand's meal-voucher point in hours earns one meal voucher of the fare brand's face value per passenger.
- A controllable cancellation or missed connection that forces an overnight stay away from the passenger's home airport earns one hotel night when the fare brand provides one.

## Goodwill

Goodwill is paid once per disruption:

| Controllable disruption | Goodwill value |
|---|---|
| Delay whose arrival lateness reaches band 1 (and not band 2) | The fare brand's band 1 delay goodwill |
| Delay whose arrival lateness reaches band 2 | The fare brand's band 2 delay goodwill |
| Cancellation or missed connection | The fare brand's cancellation goodwill |
| Delay below band 1 | None |

The bands do not add, and only the single highest amount reached is paid.

The customer takes the goodwill either as a Crestline Disruption Voucher of that amount or as Summit miles at the fare brand's miles per dollar, credited to the passenger's membership; the two forms never combine, and a customer without a Summit membership receives the voucher.

## Limits

- A customer receives goodwill at most the fare brand's number of goodwill payments in the rolling 12-month window, counted across every ticket the customer holds, using the fare brand of the disrupted ticket; beyond that cap the disruption receives meal and hotel care only. The window is the 365 calendar days ending on, and including, the flight date of the disruption being compensated, and each earlier goodwill payment is dated by the flight date of the disruption it rests on.
- Each disruption record receives at most one compensation entry of each kind.
- Denied boarding and involuntary downgrades are compensated under their own rules and never also receive goodwill for the same disruption.

## Hypothetical worked cases (Crestline Main Cabin figures)

| Controllable disruption | Care | Goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| Delay, arrival 2 h 50 min late | None | None |
| Delay, arrival 3 h late | One meal voucher of 15 dollars | 75 dollars, or 7,500 miles |
| Delay, arrival 6 h 20 min late | One meal voucher of 15 dollars | 150 dollars (band 2 is the single highest amount reached) |
| Weather delay, arrival 7 h late | None | None (uncontrollable) |
